description: This file defines an abstract class CellsFactory within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Collection namespace. It provides a static method getInstance to create a new Cells object for a given Worksheet, initializing cache settings via the Settings class.

classes.name: CellsFactory
classes.description: Abstract class serving as a factory for creating Cells objects associated with specific Worksheets, with cache initialization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Cells object for the specified Worksheet, using cache settings from Settings.
